mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_tb WHERE user_role = 0 AND active_status = '활동중'
SELECT * FROM user_tb WHERE active_status = '탈퇴'
SELECT u.id, u.name AS user_name, wr.reason, wr.details, wr.created_at FROM withdrawal_reason_tb wr JOIN user_tb u ON wr.user_id = u.id WHERE wr.user_id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM user_tb WHERE id = #{id}
select c.id, u.user_id, u.name, c.order_name, c.order_id, c.total_amount, c.approved_at, c.method, c.refund_status from charge_history_tb c join user_tb u on c.user_id = u.id order by c.id ASC
SELECT u.*, COUNT(b.id) AS board_count FROM user_tb u LEFT JOIN board_tb b ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE u.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM comment_tb WHERE user_id = #{id}
SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tb), 2) AS percentage FROM user_tb GROUP BY gender

SELECT CASE WHEN birth BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10대' WHEN birth BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN birth BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN birth BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' WHEN birth BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50대' WHEN birth BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN '60대' ELSE '70대 이상' END AS ageGroup, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM user_tb WHERE birth IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ageGroup ORDER BY ageGroup
SELECT YEAR(approved_at) AS sales_year, SUM(total_amount) AS yearly_sales FROM charge_history_tb GROUP BY sales_year ORDER BY sales_year DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_tb WHERE active_status = '활동중'
SELECT (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM charge_history_tb) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(cancel_amount), 0) FROM refund_tb) AS 총매출
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members FROM user_tb
SELECT COUNT(user_id) FROM day_record_tb WHERE date = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_posts FROM board_tb
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_comments FROM comment_tb
SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrawal_users FROM user_tb WHERE active_status = '탈퇴'
SELECT s.id AS school_id, s.name AS school_name, COUNT(us.user_id) AS user_count FROM school_tb s JOIN user_school_tb us ON s.id = us.school_id GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT avatar_id AS product_id, (SELECT name FROM avatar_tb WHERE id = avatar_id) AS product_name, COUNT(avatar_id) AS total_sold FROM inventory_tb GROUP BY avatar_id ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT avatar_id AS product_id, (SELECT name FROM avatar_tb WHERE id = avatar_id) AS product_name, COUNT(avatar_id) AS total_sold FROM inventory_tb GROUP BY avatar_id ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ur.id AS reportId, sender.nickname AS senderNickname, sender.id AS senderId, -- 신고자 ID receiver.nickname AS receiverNickname, receiver.id AS receiverId, -- 피신고자 ID ur.category, ur.content, ur.created_at AS createdAt FROM user_report_tb ur JOIN user_tb sender ON ur.sender_user = sender.id JOIN user_tb receiver ON ur.receiver_user = receiver.id ORDER BY ur.created_at DESC

SELECT br.id AS report_id, su.nickname AS sender_nickname, br.category AS report_category, br.content AS report_content, br.created_at AS report_date FROM board_report_tb br LEFT JOIN user_tb su ON br.sender_user = su.id LEFT JOIN board_tb b ON br.board_id = b.id ORDER BY br.created_at DESC

SELECT ur.id AS reportId, ur.category, ur.content, ur.created_at AS createdAt, sender.nickname AS senderNickname, -- 신고한 사람 닉네임 sender.id AS senderId, -- 신고한 사람 ID receiver.nickname AS receiverNickname, -- 신고받은 사람 닉네임 receiver.id AS receiverId -- 신고받은 사람 ID FROM user_report_tb ur JOIN user_tb sender ON ur.sender_user = sender.id JOIN user_tb receiver ON ur.receiver_user = receiver.id WHERE ur.id = #{reportId}
